question: What is the value of (72)/(22) times (11)/(3) div (21)/(9) of (18)/(7)?
solution:

The expression = (72)/(22) × (11)/(3) div (21)/(9) of (18)/(7)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ (72)/(22) × (11)/(3) div (21)/(9) of (18)/(7)

⇒ (72)/(22) × (11)/(3) div (21)/(9) × (18)/(7)

⇒ (72)/(22) × (11)/(3) div (3)/(1) times {2over1}

⇒ {72times 11over22times 18}={4over 2}=2

**∴ The required result will be 2.**
